hero.title: Get rid of pain and regain full mobility
hero.description: Spine, temporomandibular joint, and peripheral joint physiotherapy in Wrocław. Over 10 years of experience, certified Maitland manual therapy. Feel relief often after the first visit.

about.name: MSc Aneta Kołoszyńska
about.paragraph1: I am a physiotherapist with over 10 years of experience. I specialize in dental physiotherapy, orthopedic physiotherapy, manual therapy, and medical training.
about.paragraph2: I work with patients suffering from back pain and spinal problems (such as disc herniations), as well as post-surgical patients and those with injuries across the entire musculoskeletal system.
about.paragraph3: Years of working with competitive athletes have allowed me to refine my skills in rehabilitating peripheral joint injuries — sprains, dislocations, ligament and tendon damage.
about.paragraph4: In collaboration with surgeons, orthodontists, and prosthodontists, I treat patients with temporomandibular joint disorders — pain, crepitus, joint dysfunction, preparation and rehabilitation after orthognathic surgeries, and bite deprogramming.
about.paragraph5: As a functional training instructor, I conduct medical training tailored to specific needs and dysfunctions.
about.education: Graduate of the University School of Physical Education in Wrocław, specializing in orthopedic and sports trauma physiotherapy.
about.cert1Desc: A prestigious, globally recognized method of diagnosing and treating musculoskeletal disorders.
about.cert3Desc: High effectiveness in treating acute pain syndromes through fascial work.

services.title: My Specializations
services.description: Five pillars of my practice — from diagnostics to medical training. Every therapy individually tailored to your needs.

dental.title: Dental Physiotherapy
dental.description: Treatment of temporomandibular joint disorders — pain, crepitus, bruxism. Collaboration with surgeons, orthodontists and prosthodontists. Preparation and rehab after orthognathic surgeries, bite deprogramming.
dental.backText: For you if: your jaw hurts, your joint clicks, you clench your teeth at night, or you're preparing for orthognathic surgery.
dental.backMethods: Methods: Maitland, Dr. Ackermann, trigger point therapy

orthopedic.title: Orthopedic Physiotherapy
orthopedic.description: Spinal rehabilitation, post-surgical recovery, and peripheral joint injuries. Years of experience with competitive athletes — sprains, dislocations, ligament and tendon damage.
orthopedic.backText: For you if: you have back pain, disc herniations, sciatica, or are recovering from surgery or sports injury.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Precise identification of pain causes through detailed interview and functional assessment. Accurate diagnosis is the foundation of effective therapy.
diagnostics.backText: Detailed interview (15-20 min) + orthopedic and neurological tests + physical examination. I pinpoint exactly where the pain comes from — without it, the therapy won't be effective.

manual.title: Manual Therapy
manual.description: Certified Maitland techniques, Dr. Ackermann method, and FDM. Precise work with soft tissues and joints restoring proper mobility.
manual.backText: Gentle, precise joint and soft tissue mobilizations and manipulations. No sudden movements. I work within your tolerance.
manual.backMethods: Techniques: Maitland, FDM, Dr. Ackermann chiropractic

training.title: Medical Training
training.description: Functional training tailored to specific dysfunctions. Individual strengthening, stabilization, and recurrence-prevention exercise programs.
training.backText: An individual program: strengthening, stabilization, prevention exercises, and habit changes. I teach you how to maintain your body — an investment for years.

painPoints.title: You don't have to live with pain
painPoints.description: Back pain? Clicking jaw? Recovering from surgery? I help patients restore mobility and return to active life. See if your issue is listed:

spine.title: Spinal pain & disc herniations
spine.description: Lumbar, cervical, thoracic — I treat the cause, not just the symptom. Disc herniations, sciatica, protrusions — comprehensive manual therapy and rehabilitation.
spine.tip: Get up from your desk every 30 minutes — your spine needs movement, not a perfect position. Even 2 minutes of standing makes a huge difference.

tmj.title: Jaw pain & bruxism
tmj.description: Clenching teeth? Jaw clicking when eating? Together with orthodontists and surgeons, I eliminate the cause of pain so you can eat and speak without discomfort.
tmj.tip: Check right now: are you clenching your teeth? Relax your jaw — tongue on the palate, teeth slightly apart. This simple habit relieves tension.

postop.title: Post-surgical rehabilitation
postop.description: After orthopedic or orthognathic surgery — I will safely help you regain full mobility and return to daily activities.
postop.tip: The sooner you start rehabilitation, the faster the recovery. Systematic exercises, regeneration, and gradual return to load are key.

sport.title: Sports injuries
sport.description: Sprains, dislocations, ligament and tendon damage — experience with competitive athletes.
sport.tip: Pain during movement ≠ training ban. Modify, don't quit. I'll help you find a safe alternative so you don't lose your form.

headache.title: Headaches & migraines
headache.description: Tension headaches often start in the neck or jaw dysfunction. I eliminate the source.
headache.tip: 80% of cluster and tension headaches originate from the cervical spine or jaw muscle tension. Addressing basic habits like teeth clenching often makes a huge difference.

posture.title: Posture & desk pain
posture.description: Stiff neck, aching shoulders, and poor computer posture — I will help you get rid of tension and teach you how to care for your body.
posture.tip: There is no 'ideal posture'. The most important thing is changing positions frequently.

tinnitus.title: Tinnitus & dizziness
tinnitus.description: Experiencing tinnitus, ear ringing, or dizziness? The cause may be dysfunction of the cervical spine joints or temporomandibular joints, as well as soft tissue tension in this area. I will help you find the source of the problem and restore your comfort.
tinnitus.tip: Often changing daily habits, mobilization of the temporomandibular joints, or therapy of the upper cervical spine helps.

process.title: From pain to relief — feel the difference
process.description: Every visit is a journey from tension to freedom. Scroll and feel how it works.

interview.title: Untangling the knot
interview.description: I search for the true cause of pain. A thorough interview and functional assessment help me understand where the problem comes from.

therapy.title: Releasing the tension
therapy.description: Precise manual therapy — Maitland, FDM, chiropractic — restores movement, loosens tissues, and reduces pain. You feel your body regenerating.

plan.title: You regain control
plan.description: You leave with a clear plan: personalized home exercises and specific recommendations. Pain doesn't return because you know what to do.

process.note: The duration of the visit depends on the type of consultation and the chosen form of therapy. A visit usually takes approx. 30 - 45 mins. If you have them, please bring your previous diagnostic test results (e.g. MRI, X-ray, or ultrasound) to the first visit.
process.urgency: Don't wait for the pain to get worse — the sooner you start, the sooner you'll feel relief.

q1.question: How should I prepare for my first visit?
q1.answer: Bring any recent test results (X-ray, MRI, ultrasound). No referral is needed.

q2.question: Does the therapy hurt?
q2.answer: Therapy is adjusted to you. Some manual therapy techniques may cause slight discomfort, but I always work within your tolerance limits.

q3.question: How many visits will I need?
q3.answer: Acute problems often resolve in 2-3 visits, while chronic cases take longer. We'll set an exact plan during your first visit.

q4.question: Do I need a doctor's referral?
q4.answer: No, I accept private patients directly without a referral. However, please bring any past medical imaging or test results.

q5.question: How much does a visit cost?
q5.answer: The price list is available on the website and on the Znany Lekarz portal. You can pay with cash or BLIK.

q6.question: Do you accept public health insurance (NFZ)?
q6.answer: I do not cooperate with the public health system. All visits are private.
